items.title: zworld_actor_adequacy_locus PORTFOLIO (post-1002): LEG 1 = 32-dim TASK-AGNOSTIC linear compression of the encoder's actual 250-dim world_state input (random orthonormal + PCA; adjudicates H-E channel-input-capacity) and LEG 2 = information-preserving DECISION-RELEVANT re-basis of the frozen 978-OFF z_world (field-decode basis, with the closed-form decode-then-oracle content witness; ZCA / within-class whitening as secondaries; the owed H-C corroborator), on V3-EXQ-1002's dataset, capacity-matched adapter and standardiser; 10 arms x 3 seeds
items.note: PORTFOLIO for hypothesis-space question zworld_actor_adequacy_locus, routed by the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1002_2026-09-05 section 8 (parallel two-leg GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio; a 1002b power bump is REFUSED by its section 7). claim_ids DELIBERATELY EMPTY (INV-088/MECH-457 peripheral per the 978 autopsy; MECH-457 brake at 13). EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE diagnostic. | LEG 1 (H-E): ws250_full (uncompressed 250-dim input, READINESS ANCHOR, must reach 0.80), ws250_randproj (seeded random orthonormal 250->32, control; a second independent draw is fitted and reported in-cell), ws250_pca (train-split PCA-32, VERDICT ARM). pca clears 0.80 + 0.20 elevation on >=2/3 seeds -> H-E ELIMINATED (strong if the random control also clears); neither task-agnostic compression clears while the anchor does -> H-E CONFIRMED (as registered -- not a universal: the raw field is itself a task-informed 250->25 selection at 0.97+). The PCA-minus-random margin (0.10) is REPORTED as attribution, NOT a conjunct (a random compression also clearing STRENGTHENS the elimination; the margin's 1002 role was warmup attribution). Two leg-1 realisability preconditions: ws250_compression_lossy (top-32 PCs <= 0.99 variance; measured 0.865) and ws250_projection_mixes_decision_subspace (largest retained norm of the oracle's five decision coordinates world_state[232,236,237,238,242] <= 0.95; measured PCA 0.29 / random 0.39). | LEG 2 (H-C corroborator): zworld_off_diag (1002's verdict arm reproduced in-run; BASELINE), zworld_off_fielddecode (VERDICT ARM: invertible 32x32 re-basis whose first 25 axes are the train-split linear decode of the resource field + the orthogonal complement, then the diag z-score; alongside, linear_decode_oracle_agreement = the oracle's own rule applied to the decoded field, no adapter), zworld_off_zca + zworld_off_ldawhiten (secondaries), zworld_untrained_diag + zworld_untrained_fielddecode (is a lift specific to the trained latent?). Per-seed paired lift over diag: >=0.10 LIFT -> corroborated (strong if the re-based arm clears the bar; CHANNEL-LEVEL, never latent-specific, if the untrained latent lifts alike); FLAT/DEGRADE -> weakened ONLY when the closed-form content witness is itself not a lift (linear content ceiling: information, not geometry), else undetermined (reader shortfall on the decoded basis >= 0.10 has its own cell); MARGINAL / inconsistent -> undetermined. Fewer than 2 seeds -> no verdict on either leg. Re-bases are invertible linear maps: the capacity-matched adapter's function class is IDENTICAL across leg-2 arms; information preservation holds by algebra and the held-out field-decode r2 delta (~1e-7) and the transform condition numbers are recorded as WITNESSES, not gates. | OUTCOME = PASS iff BOTH legs adjudicated; labels/hypothesis_verdict carry the science; every branch informative (null table in the docstring). | DV_HEADROOM declared: agreement_elevation (ceiling headroom over the strongest trivial predictor, margin 2.0, inherited from 1002 where it passes by 0.02-0.03), agreement_absolute (raw-field ceiling 0.97-0.98 vs 0.80), rebasis_lift (1.0 minus the IN-RUN diag baseline; 1002 measured 0.648-0.674 = ~0.33 vs 0.10 x 2.0). | AUTHORING-TIME MEASUREMENT (seed 42, full scale, this adapter, Mac): rawfield 0.9846 (reproduces 1002's 0.9846 -- the dataset recipe is deterministic), ws250_full 0.940, ws250_pca 0.884, ws250_randproj 0.786/0.788 (two draws), world_state numeric rank 135, PR 14.1; within-class whitening FLAT on both projections (0.786->0.783, 0.884->0.881); raw field under a random invertible reweighting at cond 20 / 100 / 1e3 / 1e4: 0.960 / 0.938 / 0.913 / 0.877 (the reader is re-basis-sensitive, weakly at matched conditioning); oracle's rule on the true field reproduces its labels at 1.000 (no flat windows). Leg-2 full-scale latent pilot NOT completed (Mac warmup too slow under load); leg 2 is fully differential and self-witnessing in-run. | COST, STATED HONESTLY: 1002 persisted no observations or weights, so 'banked dataset' means the deterministic recipe is re-run (cheap) and the frozen 978-OFF latent is REPRODUCED by re-running the imported 978 warmup once per seed (same warmup family as 978/1002, shared by all leg-2 arms; no new family, no ree_core change; a reproduction, not a bit-identical replay -- init draw and machine class differ). Expect ~1002's runtime (314 min) plus ~30%. | GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): decisive readouts are held-out oracle_action_agreement of the adapter on (a) 32-dim linear projections of world_state and (b) decision-relevant re-bases of the frozen latent, plus the closed-form decode-then-oracle agreement -- in NO manifest (reanalysis_query.py query --readout oracle_action_agreement: 1002 is the only MATCH-class carrier and holds only the three anchor readouts). The anchors are re-run in-run because the frozen latent must be reproduced for the re-bases anyway and every comparison must be paired on one dataset instance. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. | 2.5b brake: no claim tagged; diagnostic discriminator explicitly permitted. 2.5c: SD-018 (degrading; stack.py/zworld_p0.py/agent.py) exercised by the warmup BY DESIGN (the latent must be 978's, defects included); open corrupting entries on agent.py/config.py (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082) name mechanisms the DV never reads (supervised decode of a frozen latent; action selection never consulted). | DV-SYMMETRY per arm: DV is per-state argmax agreement with the oracle's discrete action; every arm's manipulation is a change of the adapter's INPUT REPRESENTATION (raw field / 250-dim input / random projection / PCA projection / untrained latent / frozen latent / decode-basis / ZCA / LDA re-basis) -- not a broadcast constant on the logits, not a monotone rescaling of a ranked quantity, not a permutation of interchangeable units; leg-2 re-bases are absorbable by the adapter's first layer but the adapter is trained from a fresh (re-seeded) init on the re-based input, so the manipulation reaches the DV through the optimisation trajectory, which is the path H-C is about; the closed-form witness has no adapter in its path. | FINGERPRINTS: all 30 cells one mode (driver included + x1002/x724/x734/x737/x808 folded via extra_substrate_paths); re-based/sibling cells stamped reuse-ineligible (frozen agent shared from the diag cell); adapter init re-seeded from the cell seed before every fit; no arm_reuse consumer wired (no canonical baseline module exists for this lineage). | SMOKE: --self-test 21 rows + whole-cube invariants on both grids (exit 0); validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings across all 31 checks; --dry-run exit 0, all 10 arms x 1 seed exercised incl. warmup + every re-basis + the closed-form witness, correct dry-scale insufficient_seeds self-route (1 seed), validate_recording --strict OK, substrate stable across all cells, z_goal_stream recorded (no writer defect). | red-team (opus): CONTESTED, no BLOCKING, one pass (not re-spawned; no finding changed the causal chain without also being applied here). NINE findings, every one verified at source and dispositioned: F1 APPLIED (untrained-latent lift class now in the leg-2 grid; a lift on both latents is a channel-level cell, never 'strong'); F2 APPLIED (declared FLAT null had no positive control for the manipulation class -- CONFIRMED by the authoring-time whitening measurements above -- so the verdict re-basis is now the decision-relevant decode basis with the closed-form content witness and a reader-shortfall cell; whitening arms demoted to secondaries); F3 APPLIED (variance-lossy gate did not certify null realisability; decision-subspace retention gate added and recorded); F3b APPLIED (H-E-confirmed wording narrowed to task-agnostic compressions; leg-1 degeneracy flag now requires the random control green); F4 APPLIED (seeds < SEED_MAJORITY -> no verdict); F5 APPLIED (two arithmetically unfireable re-basis gates demoted to recorded witnesses; cond number now that of T); F6 APPLIED (second projection draw reported; label knife-edge disclosed, verdict unaffected); F7 DISCLOSED (worst-seed readiness vs majority verdict, conservative direction); F8 APPLIED (adapter init re-seeded per fit; leg-2 baseline described as a reproduction; all thresholds in-run); F9 DISCLOSED (DV ceiling <= 0.015 below 1.0). Findings file: scratchpad redteam_1008_opus.md.
